title: Home guide: printing tiles with card, string and paint
subject: Art & Design
unit: Spring 1: Printing and a space buggy (Moon Zoom! and Rain & Sunrays)
source: Written for art/y1 lesson 3 (Home practical guide: printing tiles with card, string and paint (portal worksheet); cover the table first)
intro: Lesson 3. Make a string tile and print a repeating sun and rain pattern. Cover the table first.

practical.aim: Make a print with a tile and print a pattern that repeats.
equipment: A square of thick card (about 10 cm)
Poster paint on a plate and a brush or sponge
Old newspaper to cover the table
safety: An adult helps with the glue
Wash your hands when you finish
method: Draw a sun (circle and rays) or rain (drops and lines) on the card.
Glue string along your lines. Let it dry.
Turn the tile over and press it on the paper. Press hard all over.
Lift the tile straight up. Look at your print!
Print again in a line, leaving the same gap: sun, rain, sun, rain.
